+This file intentionally uses only the public rcb_client observation, calibration,

+    return obs
+
+
+def action_from_obs(obs):
+    layout = obs.meta['proprio']['layout']
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    return np.array([now[layout.index('cmd_' + n)] for n in robot.spec()['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']], dtype=float)
+
+
+def pose_target(obs, side, xyz_base, rot=None, hand=None):
+    cur = action_from_obs(obs)
+    i = 0 if side == 'right' else 6
+    if rot is None:
+        rot = cur[i + 3:i + 6]
+    cur[i:i + 3] = np.asarray(xyz_base, float)
+    cur[i + 3:i + 6] = np.asarray(rot, float)
+    if hand is not None:

+    return cur
+
+

+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video='none')
+    start = action_from_obs(obs)
+    end = pose_target(obs, side, xyz_base, rot=rot, hand=hand)
+    n = max(1, round(seconds / DT))
